problems: Only taifa-of-murcia was touched (verdict fail); Arcos, Carmona, Granada, Morón and Niebla were left as the reviewer found them.

Disagreement with the first pass: the 27,800 km2 cut of the 1152 and 1169 shapes is withdrawn. Cliopatria's 1152 outline holds Castellón, Albacete, Cuenca, most of Teruel and the eastern edges of Jaén, Granada and Almería, and the Spanish Ibn Mardanis article (es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Muhammad_ibn_Mardanis) gives him Segura, Baza, Guadix, Úbeda (Jaén district 1159) and Albarracín; the outline is kept as unverified with confidence-1 bridges.

For af-02: almohad-caliphate ledger/17 (Dénia gained from taifa-of-denia in 1152) conflicts with Dénia being Ibn Mardanish's from June 1149 at the latest to 1172; ledger/46 (rest of Almohad Spain and Portugal to taifa-of-murcia, October 1228) is wider than the Andalusia drawn in the Murcia dossier; almoravid-dynasty ledger/18 (1092 Murcia) should name taifa-of-seville, not taifa-of-murcia.

taifa-of-niebla ledger/4 (1234 gain from the Almohads) should name taifa-of-murcia (Taifa overview list 'Niebla: 1234-1262'; Ibn Hud held most of al-Andalus from 1228); not edited because that dossier has verdict fix.

The Taifa overview list has 'Lorca: 1240-1265 (to Castile)' and 'Orihuela: 1239/1240-1249/1250', which disagrees with the Treaty of Alcaraz page (Lorca, Mula and Cartagena refused the treaty in 1243, Lorca and Mula conquered 1244); the treaty page is followed.

Mirrors for other dossiers: emirate-of-granada (gains from taifa-of-murcia: Jaén 1232, Granada May 1237, Almería 1238, Málaga 1239), taifa-of-valencia (Ibn Mardanish 1147-1172, Zayyan 1228/9-1238, outside Ibn Hud), crown-of-aragon (north-east strip 1169, confidence 1), crown-of-castile (Córdoba 1236, vassal_start 1243 and vassal_end 1266 with counterpart taifa-of-murcia, Lorca and Mula 1244, Cartagena 1245), kingdom-of-castile (Jerez contest 1231-1235).
